q: Rearrange the following sentences to form a meaningful paragraph: P. The initiative also encouraged residents to separate recyclable waste at home. Q. The municipal corporation launched a waste-management campaign last month. R. As a result, the amount of mixed waste reaching landfills declined considerably. S. Volunteers conducted awareness drives in several residential areas. T. They explained the environmental and economic benefits of proper waste segregation. Which is the first sentence?
exp: Q introduces the waste-management campaign. S explains the awareness drives, T elaborates on them, P adds another initiative, and R gives the result.

q: Rearrange the following sentences to form a meaningful paragraph: P. This decline was mainly caused by weak consumer demand and rising borrowing costs. Q. The latest economic report revealed that industrial production had slowed significantly. R. Analysts therefore expect the central bank to monitor growth indicators closely. S. Several manufacturing sectors recorded lower output during the quarter. T. The slowdown has raised concerns about the pace of economic recovery. Which is the first sentence?
exp: Q introduces the economic report and its main finding. S provides evidence, P explains the decline, T states its consequence, and R gives the likely policy response.

q: Rearrange the following sentences to form a meaningful paragraph: P. The bank subsequently introduced stricter verification procedures for digital transactions. Q. Customers had reported several suspicious transactions through their mobile accounts. R. The investigation revealed that most of the incidents originated from compromised passwords. S. The measures included stronger authentication and real-time transaction alerts. T. These changes were intended to reduce the risk of similar incidents in the future. Which sentence comes after Q?
exp: Q introduces the suspicious transactions. R naturally follows by explaining what the investigation discovered. P then describes the bank's response, S specifies the measures, and T gives their purpose.

q: Rearrange the following sentences to form a meaningful paragraph: P. The new policy allows small businesses to defer certain tax payments. Q. The government announced a temporary relief package for small enterprises. R. Officials believe the measure will help businesses manage short-term cash-flow problems. S. Several trade associations had requested such assistance during the recent slowdown. T. The package is expected to benefit firms facing reduced revenues. Which is the first sentence?
exp: Q introduces the government's relief package. S gives the background request, P describes a key provision, T states its expected benefit, and R explains the intended purpose.

q: Rearrange the following sentences to form a meaningful paragraph: P. The report also recommended regular training for employees. Q. A recent workplace survey highlighted a sharp increase in concerns about cyber security. R. Many employees admitted that they were unsure how to identify fraudulent emails. S. The researchers concluded that awareness was as important as technical protection. T. They therefore advised companies to conduct periodic security drills. Which sentence comes after R?
exp: Q introduces the survey. R presents a specific finding from it. S draws a conclusion from that finding, followed by T and P as recommendations.

q: Rearrange the following sentences to form a meaningful paragraph: P. Consequently, several banks began reviewing their lending standards. Q. The rise in household debt has become a major concern for financial regulators. R. Some borrowers were taking additional loans to repay existing obligations. S. Regulators warned that excessive borrowing could weaken household finances. T. They urged lenders to assess borrowers' repayment capacity more carefully. Which is the first sentence?
exp: Q introduces the central concern. R explains a reason for it, S states the regulatory warning, T gives the advice, and P describes the resulting bank response.

q: Rearrange the following sentences to form a meaningful paragraph: P. This shift has also increased demand for employees with digital skills. Q. Many companies have accelerated their adoption of remote-work technologies. R. As teams became geographically dispersed, firms invested in cloud-based collaboration tools. S. The change was initially driven by the need to maintain operations during disruptions. T. Over time, however, businesses began viewing these technologies as a way to improve flexibility. Which sentence comes after S?
exp: S explains why adoption initially increased. R describes the investment that followed. T explains the later change in perception, followed by P as a consequence.

q: Rearrange the following sentences to form a meaningful paragraph: P. The committee then proposed creating a centralized database for all participating institutions. Q. Several public agencies currently maintain separate records of beneficiaries. R. Such fragmentation makes it difficult to identify duplicate or overlapping assistance. S. The proposal is expected to improve coordination and reduce administrative costs. T. A review panel recently examined the efficiency of welfare-delivery systems. Which is the first sentence?
exp: T introduces the review panel. Q describes the problem it examined, R explains why the fragmented records are problematic, P gives the proposed solution, and S states its expected benefits.

q: Rearrange the following sentences to form a meaningful paragraph: P. This allowed them to compare price movements across different regions. Q. Economists have increasingly relied on large datasets to study inflation. R. Such comparisons can reveal whether price increases are driven by local or broader factors. S. They collected millions of transaction records from retailers and online platforms. T. The researchers used the information to identify changes in the prices of common goods. Which sentence comes after S?
exp: Q introduces the use of large datasets. S explains what data researchers collected. T describes how the data were used, P gives the immediate analytical result, and R explains its significance.

q: Rearrange the following sentences to form a meaningful paragraph: P. The findings prompted the regulator to recommend greater disclosure of such charges. Q. Consumers often focus on the advertised interest rate when comparing financial products. R. A study found that additional fees can substantially increase the effective cost of borrowing. S. These charges may include processing fees, insurance costs, and penalties. T. As a result, borrowers may select a product that appears cheaper but is actually more expensive. Which is the first sentence?
exp: Q establishes the consumer behavior. R introduces the study's finding, S gives examples of additional fees, T explains the consequence, and P gives the regulatory response.

q: Rearrange the following sentences to form a meaningful paragraph: P. The resulting uncertainty can discourage firms from making long-term investments. Q. Frequent changes in regulatory requirements can create significant compliance costs for businesses. R. Companies must repeatedly modify internal processes to accommodate the new rules. S. Policymakers therefore face the challenge of balancing necessary oversight with regulatory stability. T. While individual changes may appear minor, their cumulative effect can be substantial. Which sentence comes after R?
exp: Q introduces the problem of frequent regulatory changes. R explains the operational consequence. T emphasizes the cumulative effect, P gives another consequence, and S presents the policy challenge.

q: Rearrange the following sentences to form a meaningful paragraph: P. This dependence can make rural households particularly vulnerable to erratic rainfall. Q. Agricultural incomes in many developing regions remain closely tied to weather conditions. R. Irrigation infrastructure can reduce this vulnerability by providing a more reliable water supply. S. Climate variability has therefore become an important consideration in agricultural policy. T. In areas with limited irrigation, a single failed monsoon can severely affect household earnings. Which is the first sentence?
exp: Q introduces the dependence of agricultural incomes on weather. T gives a specific consequence, P generalizes the vulnerability, R presents a solution, and S states the policy implication.

q: Rearrange the following sentences to form a meaningful paragraph: P. However, these gains may disappear if productivity improvements fail to keep pace with wage growth. Q. Rising wages can improve household consumption and reduce financial stress. R. The relationship between wages and economic growth is therefore more complex than it initially appears. S. Higher incomes can also encourage households to spend more on education and healthcare. T. For businesses, however, rapid wage increases may raise production costs. Which sentence comes after T?
exp: Q introduces the benefits of rising wages. S adds another household benefit, T introduces the business-side concern, P explains its consequence, and R concludes that the relationship is complex.

q: Rearrange the following sentences to form a meaningful paragraph: P. Yet the same concentration can expose the system to a single point of failure. Q. Digital payment systems have transformed the way financial transactions are conducted. R. A prolonged outage at one major service provider could therefore affect millions of users. S. Their speed and convenience have encouraged widespread adoption among consumers and businesses. T. This growing dependence makes operational resilience increasingly important for financial institutions. Which is the first sentence?
exp: Q introduces digital payment systems. S explains their adoption, P introduces the risk created by concentration, R illustrates that risk, and T concludes with the importance of resilience.

q: Rearrange the following sentences to form a meaningful paragraph: P. Such a policy can nevertheless create distortions if borrowers begin relying excessively on cheap credit. Q. Lower interest rates are often used by central banks to stimulate economic activity. R. Increased borrowing can encourage businesses to expand and households to raise consumption. S. The effectiveness of the measure therefore depends on how credit conditions respond to it. T. But the resulting increase in demand may also contribute to inflationary pressure. Which sentence comes after R?
exp: Q introduces lower interest rates as a policy tool. R describes the immediate effect of increased borrowing. T introduces the inflationary consequence, P adds a further risk, and S concludes by discussing effectiveness.

q: Rearrange the following sentences to form a meaningful paragraph: P. This can make headline growth figures appear stronger than the underlying improvement in living standards. Q. Economic growth is commonly measured through changes in aggregate output. R. A rise in output, however, does not necessarily translate into an equal rise in household welfare. S. The distribution of that additional income may be highly uneven across different groups. T. For this reason, economists often examine complementary indicators such as real wages and consumption. Which is the first sentence?
exp: Q establishes the standard measure of growth. R introduces its limitation, S explains one reason for the limitation, P states the implication, and T gives the appropriate complementary approach.

q: Rearrange the following sentences to form a meaningful paragraph: P. Consequently, banks may need to revise their risk models as climate-related events become more frequent. Q. Extreme weather events can affect financial institutions through several channels. R. Borrowers may suffer losses that reduce their ability to repay loans. S. Insurers may also face larger claims, increasing the financial stress transmitted through interconnected markets. T. These effects mean that climate risk is not limited to the physical damage caused by a disaster. Which sentence comes after R?
exp: Q introduces the channels through which extreme weather affects finance. R gives the first channel, S adds another interconnected channel, T draws the broader conclusion, and P states the banking implication.

q: Rearrange the following sentences to form a meaningful paragraph: P. The problem becomes particularly serious when short-term market movements are mistaken for permanent changes in economic conditions. Q. Financial markets often react rapidly to new information. R. Investors may consequently overestimate the significance of temporary shocks. S. Such reactions can cause asset prices to move sharply even when the underlying fundamentals have changed little. T. Distinguishing temporary volatility from lasting structural change is therefore essential for sound investment decisions. Which sentence comes after S?
exp: Q introduces rapid market reactions. S explains how these reactions affect prices, R states the resulting investor risk, P specifies when the problem becomes serious, and T concludes with the investment lesson.

q: Rearrange the following sentences to form a meaningful paragraph: P. This creates a mismatch between the speed of technological change and the pace of regulatory adaptation. Q. Financial technology firms can introduce new products faster than traditional regulatory frameworks can accommodate them. R. Regulators therefore increasingly rely on flexible approaches such as regulatory sandboxes. S. These environments allow firms to test innovations under controlled conditions while regulators observe potential risks. T. The approach can help authorities understand emerging business models before deciding whether broader rules are necessary. Which is the first sentence?
exp: Q introduces the faster pace of fintech innovation. P explains the resulting regulatory mismatch, R presents regulatory sandboxes as a response, S explains how they work, and T states their benefit.

q: Rearrange the following sentences to form a meaningful paragraph: P. The data can then be used to identify patterns that would be difficult to detect manually. Q. Machine-learning systems are increasingly being used to analyze financial transactions. R. They can process enormous volumes of records in a relatively short period. S. This capability makes them useful for detecting unusual transaction behavior. T. However, the reliability of such systems depends heavily on the quality of the data used to train them. Which sentence comes after R?
exp: Q introduces machine-learning systems in financial analysis. R describes their processing capability, S explains why that capability is useful, P elaborates on the analytical benefit, and T introduces an important limitation.

q: Rearrange the following sentences to form a meaningful paragraph: P. The policy may therefore improve access without necessarily reducing the underlying cost of credit. Q. Expanding formal financial access is a major objective of many developing economies. R. Digital platforms have made it easier for underserved customers to open accounts and make payments. S. However, access to an account does not automatically guarantee access to affordable borrowing. T. The distinction is important because financial inclusion involves both availability and meaningful use of financial services. Which is the first sentence?
exp: Q introduces the objective of financial inclusion. R describes how digital platforms improve access, S introduces the limitation, P explains the implication, and T concludes by distinguishing access from meaningful use.

q: Rearrange the following sentences to form a meaningful paragraph: P. As a result, organizations are increasingly combining automated systems with human review. Q. Automation can significantly reduce the time required to process routine financial applications. R. However, automated decisions may produce errors when unusual cases fall outside the patterns present in historical data. S. Human reviewers can examine such exceptions and identify circumstances that the algorithm may have overlooked. T. This hybrid approach seeks to retain the efficiency of automation while limiting its weaknesses. Which sentence comes after R?
exp: Q introduces the benefit of automation. R presents its limitation, S explains how human review addresses that limitation, P states the resulting organizational response, and T summarizes the hybrid approach.

q: Rearrange the following sentences to form a meaningful paragraph: P. These differences can make a single national policy less effective in addressing local employment problems. Q. Labour markets often differ considerably across regions within the same country. R. One region may face a shortage of skilled workers while another experiences persistent unemployment. S. Policymakers therefore need reliable local data when designing employment interventions. T. Regional variation can arise from differences in industry structure, education, migration, and infrastructure. Which sentence comes after Q?
exp: Q introduces regional differences in labour markets. R gives a concrete example, T explains possible causes, P states the policy consequence, and S gives the resulting recommendation.

q: Rearrange the following sentences to form a meaningful paragraph: P. The immediate objective was to reduce the pressure on small borrowers during the slowdown. Q. The central bank announced a temporary restructuring framework for eligible loans. R. Banks were instructed to assess applications using standardized criteria. S. The framework did not, however, mean that all borrowers would automatically receive relief. T. Instead, lenders had to evaluate the borrower's repayment capacity and the viability of the underlying business. Which is the first sentence?
exp: Q introduces the restructuring framework. P explains its immediate objective, R describes the banks' responsibility, S clarifies that relief was not automatic, and T explains the required evaluation.

q: Rearrange the following sentences to form a meaningful paragraph: P. Such diversification can reduce the impact of a downturn in any single industry. Q. A region's economic resilience depends partly on the diversity of its productive base. R. Regions dependent on one major industry are particularly exposed to sector-specific shocks. S. Encouraging investment across multiple sectors can therefore strengthen local resilience. T. When demand for the dominant industry's products falls, employment and incomes may decline rapidly. Which sentence comes after R?
exp: Q introduces the importance of economic diversification. R identifies the vulnerability of regions dependent on one industry. T explains the consequence, P describes the benefit of diversification, and S gives the policy implication.

q: Rearrange the following sentences to form a meaningful paragraph: P. Investors may then demand higher returns to compensate for the additional uncertainty. Q. Sovereign borrowing costs are influenced not only by current fiscal conditions but also by expectations about future policy. R. If markets believe that government debt will continue rising without a credible adjustment plan, risk perceptions may increase. S. Higher borrowing costs can, in turn, make fiscal consolidation more difficult. T. This creates a feedback loop in which concerns about debt sustainability themselves increase the cost of servicing debt. Which sentence comes after R?
exp: Q introduces the determinants of sovereign borrowing costs. R describes a situation that raises risk perceptions, P states the immediate market response, S gives its fiscal consequence, and T identifies the resulting feedback loop.

q: Rearrange the following sentences to form a meaningful paragraph: P. The evidence therefore suggests that productivity growth depends on more than investment in physical capital alone. Q. Firms that invest in new machinery may initially experience higher productivity. R. Without adequate worker training, however, employees may not be able to use the new technology effectively. S. Complementary investments in skills and organizational practices can determine whether technological upgrades deliver lasting gains. T. The relationship between technology and productivity is consequently shaped by both equipment and human capabilities. Which sentence is the first sentence?
exp: Q introduces investment in machinery and its initial productivity benefit. R identifies the limitation, S explains the need for complementary investments, T broadens the conclusion, and P summarizes the evidence.

q: Rearrange the following sentences to form a meaningful paragraph: P. The change initially reduced transaction times at participating branches. Q. A public-sector bank recently introduced a digital queue-management system. R. Customers could reserve service slots through a mobile application before visiting a branch. S. Branch managers later reported that the system also helped distribute customer traffic more evenly throughout the day. T. The bank is now considering extending the system to more branches. Which sentence is the first sentence?
exp: Q introduces the bank's new system. R explains how customers use it, P gives the initial result, S adds a later reported benefit, and T states the next step.

q: Rearrange the following sentences to form a meaningful paragraph: P. The new machines consume less electricity than the older models. Q. A manufacturing company has begun replacing its outdated equipment. R. The management expects the investment to lower operating costs over time. S. The replacement programme will be completed in three phases. T. It will also reduce the frequency of unexpected breakdowns. Which sentence comes after Q?
exp: Q introduces the replacement programme. S explains its implementation, P gives one benefit of the new machines, T gives another benefit, and R states the expected financial outcome.

q: Rearrange the following sentences to form a meaningful paragraph: P. The committee recommended expanding the programme to other districts. Q. The pilot project was launched in five districts last year. R. Officials monitored attendance and learning outcomes throughout the trial. S. The results showed a noticeable improvement in student participation. T. Based on these findings, the authorities decided that the programme was worth continuing. Which is the first sentence?
exp: Q introduces the pilot project. R explains how it was evaluated, S gives the results, T states the decision based on those results, and P gives the recommendation to expand it.
